# `clear_plan`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Empty legacy plans or targets without deleting them.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xcf7f0, ParsePlanIds @0x311180, ClearPlan @0x30da50 (64-bit build) |

For each selector: with plan_id only, all targets of that plan are cleared; with plan_id and target_id, all sequences of that target are cleared. seq_id is dependency-checked but never selects a single sequence: the whole sequence map of the target is cleared. An all-unspecified selector is not an all-plans clear. Selectors are applied one by one and the call is not transactional: after the first failure earlier clears remain.

Side effects: Clears target or sequence maps of the global plan map; persists and marks the plan changed only when the cleared map was non-empty (save result not reported).

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"clear_plan"`. [READ] |
| `params` | array<object> | no | - | Array of selector objects. A plain selector object is not accepted (the parser walks child nodes directly, so an object whose member values are selector objects is also traversed and member names are ignored). A selector with target_id but no plan_id, or seq_id without target_id, is skipped; the parser succeeds if any valid selector remains. Absent, null, empty, or non-object element fails the parse (reported as 207). Range: at least 1 item(s). [READ] |
| `params[].plan_id` | integer | no | unspecified (internal sentinel -2147483648) | Legacy plan id. Range: >= -2147483648, <= 2147483647. [READ] |
| `params[].target_id` | integer | no | unspecified (internal sentinel -2147483648) | Target id within the plan; requires plan_id. Range: >= -2147483648, <= 2147483647. [READ] |
| `params[].seq_id` | integer | no | unspecified (internal sentinel -2147483648) | Sequence id within the target; requires target_id. Range: >= -2147483648, <= 2147483647. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 207 | Selector list parse failed (no error code is set by the parser, so the default applies) | `fail to operate` |
| 209 | Invalid selector dependency during clearing | `invalid value` |
| 204 | Selected plan or target does not exist | `out of limit` |
| 224 | Exposure mode 2 is active and the plan exposure worker is running | `cannot edit sequence unless reset the progress` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

## Example

Request, clear-targets - Clear all targets of plan 1 (values invented):

```json
{"id":71,"method":"clear_plan","params":[{"plan_id":1}]}
```

Request, clear-sequences - Clear the sequences of one target:

```json
{"id":72,"method":"clear_plan","params":[{"plan_id":1,"target_id":2}]}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"clear_plan","result":0,"code":0,"id":71}
```

Reply, bad-params:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"clear_plan","error":"fail to operate","code":207,"id":73}
```
